what: Expansion 1 of grammar-derived generation: the MULTIPLICITY axis, taken alone
why_alone: Value domains and cross-sheet interaction are deliberately NOT opened at the same time. Same reason the oracle correction was staged: if something breaks, the cause must be attributable to one new dimension.
why_multiplicity_first: LIM-4 came from 'two of something exists and one layer effectively handles one', so multiplicity is both the cleanest next axis and historically the most suspicious.
invariant_is_declaration_based: The primitives compare DECLARED effects against OBSERVED effects, not row counts. Three declared effects could produce a correct row count through duplication and omission cancelling out; comparing declarations cannot be fooled that way.

measures.0,1,2,3: all executed; m0..m2 each present in the output

period_measures.2,3: REFUSED (executor_cannot_honour) -- the MAX_UNPIVOTS guard from the LIM-4 fix. Multiplicity beyond 1 is untestable on this axis BY DESIGN, so it yields no multiplicity information.

derived.0,1,2,3: all executed; d0..d2 each present -- multiple derived fields are all honoured

exclusions.0,1,2,3: all executed; absent-label exclusions correctly no-ops

ignored_sheets.0,1,2,3: all executed; output unchanged by ignored material

sheetset_members.1,2,3: REFUSED. NOT a clean multiplicity test: it hits the 'sheetsets are unsupported' wall, and the accompanying column_unclassified / unresolvable_referent / sheet_unclassified codes indicate the GENERATOR builds a malformed sheetset case. The refusal is correct behaviour either way, but this axis yields no multiplicity information and the generator needs work before it does.

honest_coverage: 24 cases is the case count, not the information count. Two of six axes (period_measures>1, sheetset_members>0) hit walls rather than exercising multiplicity, so the effective multiplicity evidence covers four axes.

composition_corpus_unchanged.note: Re-verified after adding the multiplicity axis; the previously frozen corpus still reproduces exactly.

canaries.no_partial_honour: fires (pairing guard removed -> partial honour detected)
canaries.no_undeclared_output: fires (executor mutated to emit a column nobody declared)
canaries.established: each invariant is sensitive to at least one known violation
canaries.not_established: that the generators reach every violating shape
